metadata.title: Complete Topological Invariant and Coding of Homoclinic Flows on the Two-Dimensional Sphere
metadata.abstract: We study codimension one homoclinic flows on closed surfaces and introduce a complete topological invariant based on the structural graph of the flow and the distinguishing graphs of its atoms. This invariant completely determines the topological equivalence class of a homoclinic flow. For flows on the two-dimensional sphere, we construct a canonical coding algorithm that avoids the global renumbering required in the classical coding of Morse flows and substantially reduces the computational complexity. As an application, we derive recursive formulas for the number of topologically distinct homoclinic flows on the two-dimensional sphere and compute these numbers for flows with a small number of saddle singularities and closed orbits.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 流的拓扑完全不变量与编码
analysis.workSummary: 对闭曲面上的余维一同宿流，引入由结构图与各原子的区分图组成的完全拓扑不变量，决定其拓扑等价类。对二维球面构造规范编码算法，避免经典Morse流编码的全局重编号并降低计算复杂度；据此给球面上不同拓扑同宿流数量的递推式并计算小规模鞍点和闭轨道情形。
analysis.breakthrough: 将流的局部原子结构组织为可算法化的完全分类数据。
analysis.limitations: 研究特定余维一同宿流，不是任意光滑动力系统；摘要未给复杂度阶，不能补称多项式时间或精确加速比。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。第19页明确否认在本文准备中使用生成式AI，并将数学思想、不变量构造、证明、算法、数值计算与图全部归作者；这是否定声明，不是使用证据。全文与点写/断行连字模型名/Danus补检无其他正面披露，不以未见披露推断实际绝未使用。

analysis.priorityReason: 低维动力系统拓扑与算法，和几何PDE关系有限。
